import workcell
import itertools

# B1 position from vision

    x, y = bx + dx, by + dy
    r = workcell.call("robot", "insert", str(x), str(y))
    if r.ok:
        print(f"SUCCESS at x={x:.3f} y={y:.3f} (offset dx={dx:.1f} dy={dy:.1f})")
        break
    else:
        print(f"FAIL at x={x:.3f} y={y:.3f}: {r.text.strip()}")
        # If pin still held, continue; if not, we need to pick again
        if "still in the gripper" not in r.text:
            print("PIN DROPPED! Need to pick again.")
            break
else:
    print("All positions failed")
EOF
